import_provenance.original_title: Optimal space–query tradeoff for approximate Voronoi diagrams
import_provenance.original_statement: For n sites in fixed-dimensional Euclidean space, determine the optimal worst-case size of a (t,ε)-approximate Voronoi diagram: a subdivision into quadtree boxes or differences of boxes, each storing at most t sites, one of which is a (1+ε)-nearest neighbour for every query in that cell. The issue is the full tradeoff between storage and t, rather than a bound at just one endpoint.
import_provenance.supplied_caveat: Remark: Model qualification: this asks about the geometric size of the restricted representative-based AVD, not the best unrestricted nearest-neighbour data structure. Arya, da Fonseca and Mount’s 2017 polytope-membership methods already improve unrestricted approximate nearest-neighbour space bounds. https://arxiv.org/abs/1612.01696
